title: Quick Smoky Braised Jamaican Sausage Braise
description: Salty, snappy, meal-prep Jamaican dish featuring sausage and a smoky binchotan-grill braise, friendly to an Ayurvedic tamasic diet.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, and prepare the binchotan charcoal as instructed for use.
Add the sausage to the grill and cook for 2 minutes per side, until nicely browned.
Transfer the sausage to a large Dutch oven or heavy pot with a lid, and add the sliced onion, minced garlic, and diced bell pepper.
Cook the vegetables for 5 minutes, until they begin to soften, then add the Scotch bonnet peppers and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the canned tomatoes, allspice, thyme, and grated ginger. Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cover the pot, allowing the braise to cook for 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and the sausage is heated through.
Serve the braised sausage and vegetables hot, garnished with fresh thyme leaves and a side of steamed rice or roasted vegetables.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
